verdict.rationale: RustDesk is a remote desktop and self-hosted relay product. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a workflow-automation capability outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows RustDesk ships an automations feature that would make the axis apply. Its management API, centralized settings, and audit logs are adjacent administrative features, not versioned automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
